title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1995-03-18
lineage: master Cassette > DR-3 > EMU 1212M > 24/96 Wave > Wavelab 5 > plugins > r8brain > 32/44.1 wave > wavelab 5 (tracking) > L3 > 16/44.1 wave > Flac 16 (TLH lvl 8 )

ai_review.summary: High‑energy performance with Jerry’s stellar leads captured on a solid audience recording that is generally clear but occasionally muddy.
ai_review.review: The concert is celebrated for Jerry Garcia’s exceptional playing – many reviewers call it the best he ever sounded live. The audience source is praised as one of the better spring‑’95 mixes, though a few notes mention occasional muddiness that can sound like an FM broadcast. Overall the show and its recording are received very positively.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, enthusiastic comments about the musical performance (especially Jerry) combined with generally good but not flawless audience sound quality lead to a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note crispness and clear mix in many moments, though some sections are described as muddy or unclear, at times resembling an FM broadcast.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the set list as solid and the overall show as great, with no specific pacing issues mentioned.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly highlighted for his incredible leads and best‑ever playing; reviewers credit him as the main reason they love this show.
